title: One famous person's ties to places (OFFSPIN.md step 5). Checked by tools/fame.py check.

place.description: The place's name as the source gives it.

placeAliases.description: Other names the quote may use for it.

date.description: A year, a span or a decade. Undated ties are a note, not a failure.

what.description: A short label for the map: 'studied here, 1957-1960'.

landmark.description: The landmark pack id `fame.py places` gave, when the place is one.

wikipedia.description: The PLACE's own Wikipedia article title, when it has one: its coordinates come from there.

coordsFrom.description: Where lat/lon came from when given by hand: 'geocode: <address>'.

evidence.description: A verbatim quote of at least thresholds.minQuoteWords words from `source` that NAMES the place (or one of its aliases or its address).
